title: get_share_info params
description: Returns a share card for the running server. For a tcp, udp or direct-p2p server, address and port are those the server is bound to, with a detected local IPv4 address when it is bound to every interface. For a relay server the card carries the token of the previous card while that token is listed, unused and has more than half its lifetime left; otherwise a new random relay token is registered for the card, for at most 15 seconds, and other commands are handled meanwhile. Use generate_relay_token for a token of its own for each peer. The card carries the server's fingerprint as fingerprint_emoji, fingerprint_hex and fingerprint_numeric, the last being the one for the peer to compare. For a relay server with a relay_pin, relay_info.pin and the pin parameter of the url carry the relay's certificate fingerprint, which the peer passes as relay_pin to dial.
